conf.description: Tenable Security Center administrative syslog forward (RFC-3164, Configuration > Miscellaneous Settings > Syslog): PRI decode plus the same free-text message regex as the api-pull system-log path. Administrative events only (no organization-level audit entries). Direct route, no guard hop.

conf.comment: tenable-nessus / system-log / syslog-raw. RFC-3164 line from SC's local syslog forwarder. PRI gives facility/severity for free; who/from-where/success-or-failure still live only in the free-text message, same regex as the api-pull system-log pipeline. Administrative-only feed; does not replace the REST poll's organization-level audit entries.

functions.description: record parsing approach and feed-coverage caveat
split the RFC-3164 envelope into PRI, timestamp, hostname and message text
same free-text login mining as the api-pull system-log pipeline

RFC-3164 facility/severity name lookup (fixed standard table), event.severity taken directly from the decoded syslog severity since SC's three admin levels are already collapsed by the operator's PRI choice (own lookup, not shared with the vulnerability 0-4 or api-pull system-log 0/1/2 scales), stamp receive year onto the year-less RFC-3164 timestamp for _time, default event.outcome to unknown, keep event.original
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
